import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
import torch.nn.functional as F


def run(rank, ws):
    os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"] = "127.0.0.1"; os.environ["MASTER_PORT"] = str(29533 + ws)
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=100, hidden_size=32, intermediate_size=64, num_hidden_layers=5,
                      num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2)
    model = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg).float()
    ref = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg).float(); ref.load_state_dict(model.state_dict())
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1)
    inputs = [torch.randint(0, 100, (2, 8), generator=g) for _ in range(3)]
    targets = [torch.randint(0, 100, (2, 8), generator=g) for _ in range(3)]
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(model, inputs, targets, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
    tot = 0
    for x, y in zip(inputs, targets):
        l = F.cross_entropy(ref(x).logits.reshape(-1, 100), y.reshape(-1)) / 3; l.backward(); tot += l.item()
    maxd = 0; n = 0
    for (nm, p), (_, q) in zip(model.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
        if p.grad is not None:
            n += 1; maxd = max(maxd, (p.grad - q.grad).abs().max().item())
    print(rank, ws, "loss", loss, tot, "params w/grad", n, "maxdiff", maxd)
    dist.destroy_process_group()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    for ws in (1, 2):
        mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws)
